assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one square transparent inventory icon for a dark, restrained ancient Chinese fantasy exploration game.
Primary request: a single weathered charcoal-gray cloth travel boot, representing the cloud-step cultivation method. The boot has a soft wrinkled fabric shaft, faded ash-brown binding cords, a worn dark sole and just two small tarnished brass fittings. A very small thin translucent wisp of natural pale-gray ground mist touches its lower heel; the boot is the unmistakable main subject.
Style/medium: realistic hand-painted game inventory illustration with sober material texture and painterly edge control, NOT a photograph or glossy 3D render. Quiet aged materials consistent with an old bronze incense holder, weathered stone courtyards and desaturated dark-fantasy relics.
Composition/framing: centered single isolated object, clear three-quarter view, broad readable silhouette, full object entirely visible, occupies 70-80 percent of a square canvas, generous clean transparent margin, balanced icon with no base tile or frame, legible when displayed at 48 pixels.
Lighting/mood: soft natural top-left light, muted and grounded, subtle short contact shading on the object only.
Color palette: low-saturation charcoal cloth, ash gray, dull umber and tiny old-brass accents; no saturated hue.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha background, fully transparent corners; no floor, no environment, no background shadow disc.
Text: none.
Constraints: exactly one boot only; no leg or character; no scroll or book; no surrounding particles. Keep the fabric construction obvious and avoid ornate armored shin guards.
Avoid: cartoon curled clouds, cloud platform, magical swirl ring, bright glow, colored rimlight, neon cyan/green/purple, bright gold outline, saturated highlights, floating debris, neighboring icon remnants, checkerboard baked into pixels, words, letters, watermark, border.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one square transparent inventory icon for a dark, restrained ancient Chinese fantasy exploration game.
Primary request: a compact ancient stone doorway relic representing the gate-sense cultivation method. One incomplete rectangular arch of massive worn gray stone, with a chipped lintel and two short unequal uprights on a small attached broken stone sill. The stones have sparse nearly erased incised marks, a few worn iron staples and traces of dull aged bronze. The entire doorway opening is completely empty and fully transparent, crisp clean inner stone edges with no translucent film. One very narrow hairline fissure in the upper stone has a tiny muted warm-gray glimmer, entirely contained inside the opaque stone. The stone construction is the unmistakable main subject.
Style/medium: realistic hand-painted game inventory illustration with sober rough material texture and painterly edge control, NOT a photograph or glossy 3D render. Quiet aged materials consistent with an old bronze incense holder, weathered stone courtyards and desaturated dark-fantasy relics.
Composition/framing: centered single isolated object, slightly three-quarter frontal view, solid broad readable silhouette, full relic entirely visible, occupies 70-80 percent of a square canvas, generous clean transparent margin, balanced icon with no tile or frame. Legible when displayed at 48 pixels.
Lighting/mood: soft natural top-left light, subdued and grounded. A tiny warm-gray glimmer is limited to a small crack in the upper stone. No atmospheric or translucent effects anywhere.
Color palette: low-saturation weathered slate gray and ash gray, dark old iron, tiny dull old-bronze accents; no saturated hue.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha background, fully transparent corners and fully transparent open doorway; no landscape, no environment, no scene seen through doorway, no ground plane.
Text: none.
Constraints: one compact stone portal relic only, no figures, no furniture, no separate extra objects; the attached sill may have two large broken stone pieces only.
Avoid: fog, mist, translucent film, semi-transparent glow, chromatic fringe, rainbow pixels, circular ring portal, green or cyan vortex, colorful galaxy, swirling magic, neon rimlight, bright gold outline, heavy bloom, cartoon motifs, floating particles, scattered small rubble, neighboring icon remnants, checkerboard baked into pixels, words, letters, watermark, border.

cloud-step.observed: 单一旧布靴、织物纹理与土灰配色明确，无卷云平台；少量薄雾集中后跟。
limitations: 布靴偏写实细纹，在48px时主要依赖轮廓识别。
主体高度约91%，高于提示词70-80%的预期，原样保留不裁切。
四周存在alpha 1–4的低透明噪点；布带右侧与鞋尖边缘放大可见极少彩色杂点。

gate-sense.observed: 最终稿去掉门内薄雾，完整门洞透明，灰石旧铁门框清晰，暖灰光限制在门楣裂缝内。
limitations: 门框高约94%，高于提示词70-80%，页面布局需要保留外边距。
门楣左侧上边缘放大可见极少红黄色边缘杂点，仍为原型候选而非可直接游戏上线的完成素材。
四周存在alpha 1–4的低透明噪点；无程序裁切、调色或去杂点。
